paired.scope: MPS before/after only; full HIGGS rows with 100 rounds, not the published 1000-round workload or a CPU speedup claim. Same existing benchmark scripts, separate copied Python packages/libraries, fresh workers, alternating randomized order. Power state retained per run.

rejected_candidate.reason: Generic byte decoder without the 1-bit fast path regressed binary-column kernel medians by up to about 13%; replaced before acceptance.

limits: MPS before/after, not CPU or NVIDIA speedup; 100 rounds rather than the published 1000-round HIGGS workload.
All six paired workers used AC power; system-wide swap remained high. Individual timings and memory snapshots are retained.

1-, 4- and 8-bit compressed histogram microbenchmarks use randomized ordering and exact integer CPU references for every trial. Full symbol-width correctness (1..32) is covered by the existing focused native test.
The previous full 106-native/3919-Python regression remains at 41d4dc2; this production change has the focused six-native/160-Python regression recorded here.
No NVIDIA execution; no change to arithmetic, tolerances, or quantile construction.
